raw.title: Bending Nail Hammer
raw.normalExpectation: Hammering a nail drives it straight into wall.
raw.impossibleRule: Every hammer strike causes the nail to bend away from the wall at a right angle; bending increases with force.
raw.visibleTrigger: Kiko hits nail; it curves 90 degrees without entering wall.
raw.whyThisObject: Hammer is meant to apply axial force to nail; if nail deflects under any force, it cannot penetrate.
raw.goalRuleRelationship: The action to hang frame fails as nail never goes straight, preventing secure mounting.
raw.frameZeroDescription: Kiko holds hammer mid-swing, but the nail protruding from the wall is bent into a U-shape, and the picture frame leans beside him.

beats.strategy: Kiko holds the nail straight with pliers and hammers gently.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail bends around the pliers and grips them, trapping the tool.
beats.newInformation: The nail's bending is directional and can ensnare nearby tools.

beats.strategy: Kiko uses a longer nail, hoping it will go straight.
beats.visibleConsequence: The long nail curls into a spiral, then springs back and pings off the wall.
beats.newInformation: Nail length increases elasticity, causing projectile bending.

beats.strategy: Kiko pre-drills a hole, then taps the nail.
beats.visibleConsequence: The nail passes halfway, then bends sideways and splits the wallboard, making a large hole.
beats.newInformation: The nail bends at a specific depth, damaging the wall.

beats.strategy: Kiko gives up on nails and uses adhesive strips.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hammer leaps from his hand, straightens the bent nail with one tap, then hammers it perfectly into the wall.
beats.newInformation: The hammer can install nails only when not held by Kiko.

beats.strategy: Kiko grabs the hammer to adjust the picture, but the hammer now bends every nail in the house.
beats.visibleConsequence: All nails in the room curve, pictures crash, and the original nail pings into Kiko's hand, bending his thumb comically.
beats.newInformation: The hammer's bent-nail effect spreads to all previously straight nails.

raw.finalPayoff: All nails in the room curve, pictures crash, and the original nail pings into Kiko's hand, bending his thumb comically.
raw.suggestedPayoffFamily: object agency / effort causes wider damage
raw.loopPotential: Any future hanging requires avoiding hammers, but the hammer may seek Kiko out.
raw.providerRationale: Hammer's force is supposed to drive nail; nail bending under that force is visually obvious and blocks hanging.
